name: Heartwoven
label: Quest
description: Heartwoven: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.
He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.
Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm more than worried about him!

clips.title: Completion
paras: By the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.
I'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
